title: ר' יודן דכפר אימי
author: Heilprin source tradition; Warsaw digital witness

paragraphs: R. Yudan of Kefar Immi. A fire broke out; he spread his cloak over his stack, and the fire fled: Jerusalem Talmud, end of Kol Kitvei; Yoma, chapter 8, end of halakhah 5. Ein Bein HaMuddar, halakhah 9, reads R. Yonah. Heilprin takes this to be a scribal error. Bar Yehotzadak, in his name.
